answer: Imagine two identical twins building rafts from the same timber. Each raft needs its own lantern, lit by a bond of rare ore that cannot be split or bought in bulk — one lantern per raft, one bond per identity. A nebula of ten fake rafts needs ten lanterns and ten bonds, yet their light adds nothing: weight counts only the brightest single lantern per purse, so ten clones cost ten bonds and weigh as much as one. I keep one raft, one lantern, honestly lit.
